final: WITH per_telescope AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), per_status AS (SELECT t.equipstatus, AVG(p.avg_pulse) AS avg_pulse FROM per_telescope AS p JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.telescregistry = p.telescref GROUP BY t.equipstatus), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) AS baseline FROM per_status), filtered AS (SELECT s.equipstatus, s.avg_pulse, s.avg_pulse - o.baseline AS difference FROM per_status AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE s.avg_pulse > o.baseline), filtered_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) AS avg_value FROM filtered) SELECT AVG(f.avg_pulse) AS avg_step6_col2, AVG(f.difference) AS avg_step6_col3, AVG(f.avg_pulse - a.avg_value) AS avg_step6_col4 FROM filtered AS f CROSS JOIN filtered_avg AS a WHERE f.avg_pulse > a.avg_value
